description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Obtain explicit human UX acceptance of the completed attach_documents feature for Mattermost and email before authoring new or substantially expanded E2E journeys. Planning authorization on 2026-10-29 is not acceptance of the finished implementation. No application files change in this gate.

Tests to add before implementation:
None in this approval task. Keep immediate unit/integration/property tests and existing E2E execution in implementation tasks. Review demonstrations and expected outcomes for both channels: multi-iteration select A, select B, remove A, final text plus B; replace/clear; no premature file delivery; failed/cancelled requests; fresh subsequent requests.

Branches/paths validated:
Human review of final observable text/file delivery and relevant failure behavior in both channels.

Mocking plan:
No mocks or test authoring in this gate; downstream E2E records external fixture boundaries.

Documentations to update:
Record approving human, date, source message/review, approved scenarios and implementation revision in this issue. Remain open until explicit approval; reopen if material behavior changes.

Action reuse assessment:
Not applicable — human acceptance tracking only.

Owner policies: docs/testing-approach.md#feature-e2e-approval-gate, docs/e2e-testing.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Depends on implementation and validation; blocks consolidated E2E authoring.

comments.text: Ready for explicit human UX acceptance. Attached zaq-ic9.14-review.txt contains exact implementation fingerprint, all 21 changed files, validation evidence, local reproduction command, expected Mattermost/email observations, human channel review steps and local adversarial review. Current review fingerprint c5ea516210973b1de3b9fe971158e4c28bee7a7d881139675d7ac139694fc78f at base HEAD ee510663c plus uncommitted files. Evidence: real Agent/tool iteration -> only B; real Mattermost HTTP upload/post correct bytes/name/type/channel/thread; email MIME only B with body; replace/clear, cancellation/failure, fresh requests, steering and source revocation tests. Combined 376 checks and mix q passed. Focused protocol integration is explicitly distinguished from deployed full E2E; no .8 journeys authored. Human acceptance is pending; gate stays open. Final precommit deferred until .8 and .6 complete.

Human acceptance remains withheld pending explanation of Factory complexity. Read-only module-context review: Factory is the native Jido callback adapter; Action validates Records, AttachmentSelection owns pure mutation/replay, Jido agent.state owns request-local selection, StreamEvents observes final snapshot, Channels owns delivery. Factory gained roughly 176 lines because parent-owned serial mutation and redaction must precede Jido native trace/stream/thread capture (pinned strategy processes those before applying generic effects). Maintainability concerns: feature-specific event dispatch/redaction/transport live inline beside generic runtime assembly; selection tracking/filtering currently touches requests with the tool disabled; synthetic checkpoint plus terminal sequence rewriting couples the feature to native stream mechanics. Smallest proposed simplification is thin Factory callback delegation to a cohesive attachment runtime adapter, retaining the existing pure reducer and owning Jido process; narrow unrelated-runtime effects and separately reassess snapshot transport rather than merely moving its complexity. Preserve native request/PID binding, deterministic order/replay, freeze/discard, privacy, busy/cancel acknowledgement handling and final delivery. Existing runtime/stream/delivery/property tests are the regression surface. No production code or tests modified during this inspection; .8 stays blocked. Refactor implementation is not being inferred from this explanatory question.

Read-only epic minimality review requests changes: all 21 changed files inventoried (412 production additions, 1221 tests/support, 53 docs). Four medium findings: disabled-tool requests unnecessarily enter attachment event filtering; synthetic checkpoint/direct sink/terminal seq rewriting couples selection to native protocol; Factory owns inline feature policy beyond thin hooks; signed-identity test uses invalid signatures and only verifies fallback identity. Required Action/registration/propagation and approved provenance fix remain justified. Report /tmp/zaq-ic9.14-minimality-review.txt. No source/tests changed or validation rerun. UX acceptance still pending; no issue closed.

Authorized cleanup completed and validated; attached updated review evidence supersedes prior implementation fingerprint. Four review findings addressed. Factory additions 176 -> 25, focused adapter added, disabled requests unaffected, private snapshot uses existing sink without synthetic event or sequence rewriting, signed identity test corrected and unsigned fallback removed. 307 checks and mix q pass. Human UX acceptance remains pending; cleanup approval is not UX acceptance. No .8 E2E authored, no precommit/commit/push/sync. Review steps and limitations in attachment.

Human UX investigation (read-only): transcript b4ea1d44-9901-4448-a7de-3cf2cffd0731 persisted execution evidence shows list_documents first guessed provider gdrive/path / -> no_bridge gdrive; correction produced no tool call; later disk listing passed host-relative file path priv/documents/test_image.png -> volume_required. Enabled Disk config10 has documents and archives volumes. Correct folder listing contract is provider disk/config_id 10/path documents; actual Storage split_parent recognizes configured volume names. HelpMe agent2 has list_documents/download_document/attach_documents enabled, but no get_document; job only generic answer instruction. This is provider/path selection and guidance evidence, not an attachment-selection execution failure (attach_documents never called). Supplied explicit wording; no config/code mutation, no UX acceptance inferred. .8 remains blocked.

Human UX evidence: after granting public read, execution a2f49858-1d80-4e8a-ab68-3c862f6d3526 for and now successfully listed config10/documents (count1 test_image.png) and attach_documents succeeded. One execution/one canonical answer69f239e5-302c-4df2-8047-f6d4cb5d2a64, but metadata.external_message_id=x9kym69t3td1zqfnuh48k33rca differs from external_message_id/delivery receipt4irgqimq83bftj1e35ux9m41qc. User reports two responses. Code confirms JidoChatBridge.send_mode attachments clause unconditionally :create, bypassing existing streamed-message update; final file post repeats answer body. This is a delivery UX defect, not duplicate agent execution. Native provider posts not directly fetched; conclusion supported by saved IDs + delivery branch + user observation. UX gate remains unsatisfied; no E2E authorization inferred, no source/config changes during diagnosis. Resolve streamed answer plus final attachment duplication before acceptance.

Duplicate Mattermost reply locally fixed and red regression now green; 244 application regression checks,66 adapter checks,mix q pass. Requires local dev server reload/restart to load modified dependency before manual retry. Re-review: existing documents/config10 readable file -> select/attach -> one streamed post updated with same answer+image, no second caption/post. Check original post/thread unchanged. New and existing source changes remain uncommitted; separate adapter checkout patch attached to .4, dependency publication/pinning still pending explicit authorization. This is not human UX acceptance; .7/.8/.6/final precommit remain gated.
